entities.summary: Fresno is a Brazilian rock band formed in Porto Alegre in late 1999. As of 2020, members are Lucas Silveira, Gustavo Mantovani and Thiago Guerra (drums). The band has released ten studio albums, with an upcoming eleventh record titled "Carta de Adeus", set to come out in 2026.
